measurement_definitions.completed: True only when the task completion rule is met before the observer ends the attempt; otherwise false.
measurement_definitions.error_count: Count discrete wrong, missing, duplicated, or blocking outcomes against the task completion rule; an incomplete measured task must record at least one error.
measurement_definitions.latency_ms: Monotonic wall-clock milliseconds from the observer's first user action in the written procedure until its completion rule is met or the measured attempt ends.
measurement_definitions.interaction_count: Count intentional clicks, taps, or key gestures in the documented primary flow; permission approvals count, spoken words do not.

tasks.title: Install to first successful dictation
tasks.procedure: On a supported clean machine, follow only the product's public primary installation path, grant requested permissions, and complete one dictation.
tasks.completion_rule: Complete when intended text first appears in the target application without undocumented setup steps.

tasks.title: Reach ready state
tasks.procedure: Launch the installed product and reach its documented ready-to-dictate state.
tasks.completion_rule: Complete when the product visibly indicates that dictation can begin.

tasks.title: Enter a short message
tasks.procedure: Dictate: Please send the revised agenda before lunch.
tasks.completion_rule: Complete when the final target contains the intended sentence with equivalent capitalization and punctuation.

tasks.title: Enter numbers and units
tasks.procedure: Dictate: Set the sample rate to 48 kilohertz and the buffer to 256 frames.
tasks.completion_rule: Complete when both quantities, units, and their associations are correct in the final target.

tasks.title: Correct one dictated word
tasks.procedure: Dictate a short sentence, then use the product's documented correction flow to replace one incorrect word.
tasks.completion_rule: Complete when the intended replacement appears once and the surrounding sentence remains intact.

tasks.title: Enter two sentences
tasks.procedure: Dictate: The prototype is ready for review. Please add comments by Friday.
tasks.completion_rule: Complete when both intended sentences appear in order without duplicated or missing words.
